title: How do I manage if my child is resistant to participating in Occupational Therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Dealing With Resistance in Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our seasoned occupational therapists are equipped with creative approaches to tackle resistance and engage children with compassion, making therapy an engaging experience.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that adjusting to therapy can be a daunting task for some children. Our occupational therapists are well-trained and equipped with creative approaches to deal with resistance and engage your child. We infuse fun by incorporating your child's interests in the sessions, modify the environment suitably, and use positive reinforcement techniques extensively. As a parent, your collaboration is invaluable. Regular communication with our therapists about your child's preferences, moods, and subtle hints, can together help us create an environment where your child feels safe, valued, and ready to participate.
